1HighOvercast and fog keep a vivid blue day sky
Frames 25–30 (day overcast/fog) show the same saturated blue sky as dry; fog is only low ground haze, no whiteout. Day wet/rain/storm (19–24, 31–33) do grey out, so the weather blend works for rain but not overcast/fog.		Engine/lighting, not circuit data: js/lighting/atmosphere.js (PR #1979 merge) sky blend by weather; check overcast/fog branches. Circuit def.pal (js/circuits/jeddah.js:37) is a night palette and is not the day sky.Measured from frames; cause in atmosphere.js not traced line-by-line.
